member.summary: Builds the hierarchy from FBX Model objects, including the full FBX transform pipeline (translation + rotation pivots, offsets, pre-/post-rotation, rotation order, geometric transform).
member.remarks:
FBX's "Transform" on a Model is the product of nine 4x4 matrices applied in this order:
World = Parent * T * Roff * Rp * Rpre * R * Rpost^-1 * Rp^-1 * Soff * Sp * S * Sp^-1
We collapse that into a single local TRS by composing the whole chain and decomposing the resulting matrix. Geometric translation/rotation/scale (a per-node "object-space" offset that FBX applies between the node transform and the geometry, NOT inherited by children) is baked directly into the geometry vertices because our node has a single TRS, not a separate slot for it.

member.summary: Generates per-vertex tangents from positions, normals and UV0 using the algorithm from Eric Lengyel's "Computing Tangent Space Basis Vectors for an Arbitrary Mesh".

Tangent stream layout matches MikkTSpace: (tangent.xyz, bitangent_sign). The bitangent is reconstructed in the shader as cross(normal, tangent.xyz) * tangent.w.
The full MikkTSpace algorithm gives bit-exact results for mirrored UV islands and is preferred for authoring pipelines that pre-bake their tangents the same way. The Lengyel method used here produces visually correct results for typical game content and avoids the ~1500 lines of C from the reference. A future phase may swap in the MikkT port behind the same flag.

member.name: T:Prowl.Clay.PostProcess.ConvertCoordinateSystemStep
member.summary: Converts the scene from its native coordinate system into the target convention (left-handed, Y-up, +Z forward).

Positions, normals, tangents, morph deltas and animated positions go through the axis map.
A quaternion's vector part becomes the negated axis map of it, which keeps it a rotation.
Scale only has its axes permuted.
Triangle winding and the tangent bitangent sign flip.
Inverse bind matrices are conjugated by the axis map.
